name: Santa Clara County, California (United States)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow map of the county bearing a white star, within a border of yellow stars, with the words SANTA CLARA COUNTY and the date 1850 in white.
history: Santa Clara County is a county in the San Francisco Bay Area. According to the county's Office of Public Affairs, quoted on Flags of the World, it had no official flag for 125 years until a contest by the county Historical Heritage Commission produced one for the United States Bicentennial in 1976.
